0.content:
# 🚀 What my Bindplane pipeline did
Pick one or more names in **Project** (or **`*`** for the whole class). The payments section has its own **Cluster** selector, because those logs come from your Kubernetes cluster, not through Bindplane. Every tile below is live data from the pipelines built in the lab: what you collected, how you shaped it at the edge, what you **didn't** have to send or store, and what Dynatrace can do with it once it lands.

| Stage | Bindplane did this at the edge | Why it matters |
|---|---|---|
| 🏷️ Label | `project` stamped on every record | find your data in a busy tenant with one filter |
| 🧩 Parse | 38 named `pan.*` fields from raw CSV | no regex at query time, faster dashboards and alerts |
| ✂️ Reduce | raw CSV removed, routine traffic sampled | less to ship, ingest and store |
| 🔐 Mask | credentials hashed before leaving the host | secrets never reach any backend in clear text |
| 📈 Metrics | log events turned into a time series | cheap, fast trend queries and alerting |
| 🔎 OpenPipeline | syslog parsed **in Dynatrace on ingest** | no collector change needed, severity and fields for free |
| 💳 Business data | payment JSON turned into `app.payment.*` fields | revenue, card mix and loyalty straight from logs |

5.title: Firewall records dropped at the edge
5.query:
fetch logs
| filter (in("*", array($Project)) or in(project, array($Project))) and appname == "PAN-OS" and isNotNull(pan.action)
| lookup [
  fetch logs
  | filter isNotNull(project) and appname == "PAN-OS" and isNotNull(pan.action)
  | makeTimeseries { allow = countIf(pan.action == "allow"), total = count() }, by: { project }, interval: 1m
  | fieldsAdd idx = arrayFirst(arrayRemoveNulls(iCollectArray(if(total[] >= 30 and allow[] / total[] < 0.8, iIndex()))))
  | filter isNotNull(idx)
  | fields project, milestone = "06 Sampling", first_ts = timeframe[start] + interval * (idx + 1)
], sourceField: project, lookupField: project, prefix: "s_"
| filter isNotNull(s_first_ts) and timestamp >= s_first_ts
| summarize { a = countIf(pan.action == "allow"), o = countIf(pan.action != "allow") }
| fields v = concat(toString(round(100.0 * a * 9 / (a * 10 + o), decimals: 0)), "%")

6.title: Secrets hashed
6.query:
fetch logs
| filter (in("*", array($Project)) or in(project, array($Project))) and log.file.name == "audit.log" and contains(content, "BCH_ACCESS_KEY_ID=")
| parse content, "LD 'BCH_ACCESS_KEY_ID=' NSPACE:bch_ak SPACE 'BCH_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=' NSPACE:bch_sk"
| fieldsAdd bch_sk = replaceString(bch_sk, "\"", "")
| filter stringLength(bch_ak) >= 64 and stringLength(bch_sk) >= 64 and not startsWith(bch_ak, "BCHK")
| summarize v = count()

8.title: Raw CSV kept off the wire
8.query:
fetch logs
| filter (in("*", array($Project)) or in(project, array($Project))) and appname == "PAN-OS"
| summarize {
    raw_bytes = avg(if(contains(content, ",TRAFFIC,end,"), stringLength(content))),
    stripped = countIf(isNotNull(pan.action) and (isNull(content) or content == ""))
  }
| fields v = concat(toString(round(raw_bytes * stripped / 1048576, decimals: 2)), " MB")

9.title: At this rate, per day
9.query:
fetch logs
| filter (in("*", array($Project)) or in(project, array($Project))) and appname == "PAN-OS" and pan.action == "allow"
| lookup [
  fetch logs
  | filter isNotNull(project) and appname == "PAN-OS" and isNotNull(pan.action)
  | makeTimeseries { allow = countIf(pan.action == "allow"), total = count() }, by: { project }, interval: 1m
  | fieldsAdd idx = arrayFirst(arrayRemoveNulls(iCollectArray(if(total[] >= 30 and allow[] / total[] < 0.8, iIndex()))))
  | filter isNotNull(idx)
  | fields project, milestone = "06 Sampling", first_ts = timeframe[start] + interval * (idx + 1)
], sourceField: project, lookupField: project, prefix: "s_"
| filter isNotNull(s_first_ts) and timestamp >= s_first_ts
| summarize { a = count(), st = min(s_first_ts), lt = max(timestamp) }, by: { project }
| fieldsAdd per_day = a * 9 / ((lt - st) / 1m) * 1440
| summarize v = concat(toString(round(sum(per_day) / 1000000, decimals: 2)), " M")

18.title: Raw, as it arrives (one long CSV string)

19.title: Structured by Bindplane (named fields, no regex)
19.query:
fetch logs
| filter (in("*", array($Project)) or in(project, array($Project))) and appname == "PAN-OS" and isNotNull(pan.action)
| sort timestamp desc
| limit 10
| fields timestamp, project, pan.action, pan.app, pan.src_user, pan.src_ip, pan.dst_ip, pan.dst_port, pan.bytes, pan.session_end_reason

20.title: Dynatrace: parsed at query time (schema on read)
20.query:
fetch logs
| filter (in("*", array($Project)) or in(project, array($Project))) and appname == "PAN-OS" and contains(content, ",TRAFFIC,end,")
| fieldsAdd action = splitString(content, ",")[31]
| summarize sessions = count(), by: { action }
| sort sessions desc

28.content: ## ✂️ Volume reduction — keep every deny, sample the routine

29.title: Firewall records per minute — allow vs deny/drop/reset
29.query:
fetch logs
| filter (in("*", array($Project)) or in(project, array($Project))) and appname == "PAN-OS" and isNotNull(pan.action)
| makeTimeseries { allow = countIf(pan.action == "allow"), deny_drop_reset = countIf(pan.action != "allow") }, interval: 1m

30.title: Allow share (%) — drops from ~93% when sampling starts
30.query:
fetch logs
| filter (in("*", array($Project)) or in(project, array($Project))) and appname == "PAN-OS" and isNotNull(pan.action)
| makeTimeseries { allow = countIf(pan.action == "allow"), total = count() }, by: { project }, interval: 1m
| fieldsAdd allow_share_pct = 100 * allow[] / total[]
| fields timeframe, interval, project, allow_share_pct

31.title: Raw CSV bytes per minute — gone after Delete Fields
31.query:
fetch logs
| filter (in("*", array($Project)) or in(project, array($Project))) and appname == "PAN-OS"
| fieldsAdd raw_bytes = if(isNotNull(content), stringLength(content), else: 0)
| makeTimeseries raw = sum(raw_bytes), by: { project }, interval: 1m
| fieldsAdd kb = raw[] / 1024
| fields timeframe, interval, project, kb

32.content: ## 🔐 Masking — leaked cloud credentials, hashed in flight

33.title: Credential records per minute — raw vs hashed
33.query:
fetch logs
| filter (in("*", array($Project)) or in(project, array($Project))) and log.file.name == "audit.log" and contains(content, "BCH_ACCESS_KEY_ID=")
| parse content, "LD 'BCH_ACCESS_KEY_ID=' NSPACE:bch_ak SPACE 'BCH_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=' NSPACE:bch_sk"
| fieldsAdd bch_sk = replaceString(bch_sk, "\"", "")
| fieldsAdd state = if(startsWith(bch_ak, "BCHK"), "🔓 raw", else: if(stringLength(bch_ak) >= 64 and stringLength(bch_sk) >= 64, "🔒 hashed", else: "⚠️ partial"))
| makeTimeseries records = count(), by: { state }, interval: 1m

| summarize { records = count(), first_seen = min(timestamp), last_seen = max(timestamp) }, by: { project, state }

40.title: NetFlow bytes per minute (MB)
40.query:
fetch logs
| filter (in("*", array($Project)) or in(project, array($Project))) and receiver == "netflow"
| makeTimeseries b = sum(flow.io.bytes), by: { protocol = network.transport }, interval: 1m
| fieldsAdd mb = b[] / 1048576
| fields timeframe, interval, protocol, mb

41.title: Top destination ports by bytes

| summarize mb = round(sum(flow.io.bytes) / 1048576, decimals: 1), by: { port = destination.port }
| sort mb desc
| limit 10

42.title: Top talkers
42.query:
fetch logs
| filter (in("*", array($Project)) or in(project, array($Project))) and receiver == "netflow"
| summarize { flows = count(), mb = round(sum(flow.io.bytes) / 1048576, decimals: 1), packets = sum(flow.io.packets) },
    by: { source = source.address, destination = destination.address, port = destination.port }
| sort mb desc
| limit 15

53.content: ## 💳 Business data from logs — astroshop payments (pick your name in **Cluster**)

54.title: Payments decoded
54.query:
fetch logs
| filter k8s.namespace.name == "astroshop" and matchesPhrase(content, "Transaction complete.")
| fieldsAdd participant = if(startsWith(k8s.cluster.name, "bindplane-logs-") and stringLength(k8s.cluster.name) > 24, substring(k8s.cluster.name, from: 15, to: stringLength(k8s.cluster.name) - 9), else: k8s.cluster.name)
| filter in("*", array($Cluster)) or in(participant, array($Cluster))
| filter isNotNull(app.payment.transactionId)
| summarize v = count()

55.title: Revenue made visible
55.query:
fetch logs
| filter k8s.namespace.name == "astroshop" and matchesPhrase(content, "Transaction complete.")
| fieldsAdd participant = if(startsWith(k8s.cluster.name, "bindplane-logs-") and stringLength(k8s.cluster.name) > 24, substring(k8s.cluster.name, from: 15, to: stringLength(k8s.cluster.name) - 9), else: k8s.cluster.name)
| filter in("*", array($Cluster)) or in(participant, array($Cluster))
| filter isNotNull(app.payment.transactionId)
| summarize total = sum(toDouble(app.payment.amount)), by: { app.payment.currencyCode }
| sort total desc
| limit 1
| fields v = concat(app.payment.currencyCode, " ", toString(round(total, decimals: 0)))
